title: 15 Principles for Effective Witnessing Part 2
paragraphs: 15 principles to effectively win everyone for the Kingdom of God. I would like to change that subject or title today to something a bit more focused, namely 15 principles to win your worlds. 15 principles to win your worlds for Christ. This comes from the series we are working on this year. I teach about discipling every discipline, and we discuss the need for the 21st- century church to come into more contact, not with heaven, but with the earth.

The church has become so familiar with heaven that the earth has become strange territory. That is really no blessing. We ought to be in contact with heaven, for our citizenship is in heaven, but our mission is on earth. And that is why the Bible calls the Christian believer an ambassador. An ambassador does not live in the country he represents. He lives in the strange country. But he represents the country he comes from in that country.

And while he is in that country, he must study the language, learn the culture, and then convey the laws, principles, and interests of his country to the country where he resides. That is an ambassador. The same applies to us as believers in the kingdom of God. We are in the world, but we are not of the world. We are staying here, but this is not really where we come from. This is our assignment. However, the earth to which we have been sent also belongs to our government.

And this is where the difference between the two kingdoms diverges. If you represent a country on Earth and you are an ambassador to another country, then the country where you are does not belong to the government you come from. But in the kingdom of God, this is where the difference lies. The territory in which we find ourselves is also the property of the government of the country we come from. This is what the constitution of our country says about this territory.

It says: "The earth is the Lord's, and all that it contains, the world and those who dwell in it, belong to God." Therefore, the planet on which we find ourselves belongs to us by inheritance and also by responsibility. This is why the command to man to control the earth was so important to God. God wanted His territory to be managed and overseen by His own children, whom He Himself made kings and rulers of the realm. What is amazing is that He has given us dominion and power over all of this.

That means, then, that it is His responsibility to take care of His ambassadors. Our responsibility is to represent His kingdom. And this is what being a Christian is all about, so to speak. The word Christian is not used by Jesus in the Bible to describe us. What Jesus uses in the Bible to describe us is actually sons. Jesus used that word often. He says: " You are sons of God." He then also speaks of us as sons in the kingdom of the Father, which means that we are citizens of a government.

The Kingdom is dealing with citizenship. So we are not only sons of the king, but also citizens of the king's kingdom, and we are also rulers in His kingdom, which also makes us kings who are under the king. It is a very interesting complication, isn't it? That is why the constitution in the Bible ends this way. He is the King of kings, and He is the Lord of lords. Why? Because those over whom He rules are also kings. And those over whom He rules are also the lords of the earth. They are the lords of the planet.

And that is what you are and what I was created for. However, this is where we make our mistake. This privilege does not belong to the church. It belongs to humanity. Please write that down. The privilege of sonship and dominion and power over the earth is not exclusively a privilege of the church. I believe that this is the reason why the church is so introverted, isolated, and in many respects irrelevant. Because we have come to believe that the church is God's favorite and the world is God's enemy.

This is incorrect. It is as if you were saying that the son who is in the house is God's son, but the one in the pigsty is God's enemy. That is not true. The one in the pigsty is also God's son. In fact, God the Father is more interested in the son in the pigsty than in the one in the house, based on the scenario that Jesus gives us. He says that the Father is waiting patiently and anxiously for that boy to come home. And when that boy came home, it is inconceivable to me that the Father ran to him and kissed him.

Let me ask you a question that I also asked a few weeks ago. Why did n't the eldest brother go look for his brother? Because he is an image of the church. He is just happy to be home. He is just happy that he got the fattened calf. He is just happy that he got his coat and his shoes. He is just happy that he got his ring and he hasn't been promiscuous and hasn't disappointed God, and he has always been with God and was always saved, and you always look like this, right?

And the worst part of this church home is when it is time for the prodigal son to come home, then you get angry with the father because he gives him more attention. I am beginning to understand that the call to repentance in a church service is the most dangerous moment. For it is dangerous, because the eldest sons then begin to say that it is time to go. That is enough. I do n't have time to wait until they come home. I have to do this. I have to go do that. I forget them.

We have the same attitude as that boy who was at home. My point is this. The world is not the enemy of God. And when I say the world, I am not referring to the spirit of the world, which is the system, the cosmos ruled by Satan. I am talking about the world in the sense of humanity. For God so loved the world. The Bible nowhere says: for God so loved the church. I cannot find it in the Bible. He does say: for God so loved the world. And who is the world? You, before you were saved. This is how I phrase it.

For God so loved the world that He gave His only begotten Son. For God's Son so loved the world that He gave His only begotten church. Mhm. So, the Son was sent by the Father. Hey. And the church was sent by the Son. And the goal is the same. To do what? To love the world to bring the sons back to their rule and to their dominion. The church exists for the nation. Not for heaven. The mission of the church is not to reconcile the church with heaven, but rather the world with God.

The role of the believer is to be an ambassador of the kingdom of God, not to flee responsibility on earth. We are known, as Paul says, as ministers of what? Reconciliation between God and man. We are more concerned about reconciling the church with God than about reconciling God with the world. That is why most books appearing now, as we enter the 21st century, focus on the Rapture and the Second Coming of Jesus. I want to confess to you, my friends, that I have a problem with that.

Christ cannot possibly come on the day of the year 2000. If He were to do that, I would be disappointed in my Savior. I do not want Him to come, because if He comes, He would break His word. He would then actually have presented Himself incorrectly to me. For He said that the end will come after this gospel has been proclaimed to all nations as a testimony for them. And today, my friends, there are 1 billion people in China. 99% are Buddhist, Hindu, Muslim, or Shintoist. They do not know Christ.

Some of them have never heard the name of Jesus in their own language. Can He come then? He would break His word. 989 million people in India, soon to be 1 billion, and 99% of them are Muslim or Hindu. They have not heard the word of Jesus well. Tell me, can Jesus come? No. Only because we say that we are ready and want to leave, or want Him to come. But we are selfish. We missed the assignment. The task is those people, not heaven.

You may really clap loudly if you understand this, because that is the message of the church to me. Jesus clearly established the purpose of the church on earth. Matthew 28:18, we all know it. He says: go out into the whole world and what? Make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit. And then teach them, He said. Teach them to observe all that I have taught you, and I will always be with you. He said: Teach the nations His principles.

That is what He taught us. He taught us principles. He taught us the principles of the kingdom of God. He says: Go and teach the nations about My principles. My friends, the word ' people' is a strange word. Please write down the word: people. It is the word 'ethnos' in the Greek language, and that word 'ethnos' in this specific sense naturally has to do with special groups.

We derive our word 'ethnic' from that word 'ethnos', but ethnic has become such a loaded word, because for us, ethnic simply means a certain skin color, doesn't it? This word 'ethnos ' is not related to or limited to skin color alone. It has the meaning of a special grouping. Everyone say: ethnos. That is the word used here for nations. And this word ethnos means any group that has a common interest, a common language, a common uh uh uh principle, a common uh devotion. That is an ethnos.

We call America a nation because it has agreed to abide by a common constitution. We call the Bahamas or Ghana or India or Haiti, we call them nations because these are many different peoples, but to what do they dedicate themselves? One common constitution. That is why we call them an ethnos. But if you go to the United States, it is not an ethnically united country.

You have people of every color, every culture, and different languages ​​in America, but they all form one ethnos, which means that their skin color does not make them one. It is rather that constitutional commitment to that piece of paper they have agreed to follow together that makes them a nation. Are you still following me? Are you still following me? I want to convey this to you now. Therefore, Christ did not say that you must go to every constitutional nation to preach the gospel. He didn't say that.

He said that you must go to every common grouping that has a common language with a common commitment to a common constitutional obligation, and go to that specific group to preach the gospel. The word preach means to proclaim and to demonstrate. It doesn't necessarily mean that you have to talk all the time. You can preach with your life, preach with your attitude, or preach with your lifestyle, or preach with your work ethic. Hello? You can preach with the quality of your work, the way you produce.

All that is preaching. The word means to demonstrate. I believe that Christians talk too much. When we testify. You tell people how good God is, and you keep coming to work late. So, they get confused. God is good, but apparently he cannot make you arrive on time. You see, you are confusing the message. Your life is more powerful than your words. Ethnos. Everyone say: ethnos. Go to every ethnos and what? Proclaim and demonstrate the gospel of the kingdom.

That means that any group that has a common commitment and a common constitution is an ethnos. Let me give you some examples. There is an ethnos called dentistry. All dentists have a common law, a common language. They speak different languages ​​than we do. They say words that we do not understand. So, God says: "I want you to go into the world of dentistry and proclaim my kingdom." What about the legal profession? Lawyers speak a different language. He says: "Go into the world of justice and preach the gospel."

What about the business world? He says: "I need people who enter the business world, stay there, and become the forerunners of the business world." He says: "Then the political world, a different language. He says: 'Go there and preach the gospel to that world of politicians.'" What about teachers? What about people in the media? What about entertainers? What about athletes and the sports world? What about the world of children, the world of adolescents, or the world of young adults?

He says: "Go into that world and preach the gospel." In other words, he says: "I don't want a church with someone in a black collar and a black robe. I want a church that is so diverse that you don't know who they are. They are like secret agents everywhere, and they are present there." He says: "The kingdom of God is like a mustard seed. You simply plant it in the middle of the business system and leave it there." He says: "And then it grows and grows and grows until the birds come and eat of the fruit."

He said: "The kingdom of God is like taking a wife and placing her in the midst of politics." He says: "And just as you put yeast in the dough, the kingdom of God is like a woman who puts a little yeast in the dough, but when it is finished, the whole dough is influenced by the yeast, for it is a growing kingdom." And then he says: "As soon as you place the kingdom in a situation, listen to his promise. He says:" The gates of hell cannot stop that yeast. I do n't know, but I'm about to cheer all by myself.

I say: come on, people. I just felt the anointing come over me. I'm going to talk to myself. You are tired, but I feel something now. God says: listen, if I place you in aviation, no matter how big and difficult it seems, they cannot stop what you are going to do there, because you are stronger than the work of the devil. Listen to his words. I shall build something on this rock. My church. I am going to place my church in the middle of education. Hello, anyone? You are joining the school board.

Say to your neighbor: " Watch out, I'm coming. I'm coming. I'm coming. I'm coming. I'm coming." Say it again: "I'm coming. I'm coming. I'm coming. I'm coming. I'm coming." Say it out loud: "I'm coming. I'm coming. I'm coming.

I'm coming. I'm coming." I am no longer preparing. I'm on my way. We must influence and change the world we live in. I am fed up with a church that only thinks about heaven. While their brothers in the mud pool go to hell. And please don't quit your job to go into service. That is what I am trying to tell you today. Stay in your service. Yes, that is in education, in the business world, in law, in the hotel sector, and with the police. Stay in it, says God. That is where your task lies.

Clap your hands once out of faith. The primary goal and mission of the church is not to go to heaven. If that were the primary goal, God would have killed us long ago. The fastest route to heaven is death. To show you how little God wants you in heaven, the constitution of the kingdom provides for healing. Well, that was a weak round of applause. I want everyone to applaud for that. God says: "I am going to keep you there as long as possible." For you are of no use to God in heaven.

Let me tell you what this series is about. Discipleship in every discipline. This series is about starting to smell like pigs.

Have you ever wondered what the story Jesus told about the church and the lost means? People call him the prodigal son, but that is what it is about. Have you ever wondered why the Bible never says that the father left home to look for him?

I want you to think about this for a moment. Who was happy when the son returned? Father. Who rejoiced? Father. Who threw a big party? Father. That means, who was excited to see him? Father. That means, who wanted him back? Father. Why is it that he never went looking for him? Because he is waiting for someone to look for him. Yes, that grumbler. Let me tell you something. The reason why God is so smart. It is the people in the house who have time to grumble.

If you have nothing to do, the only thing you can do is criticize. Why are you slaughtering the fattened calf for him? Why are you doing that? Why are you throwing a party for him? What is, what is wrong? Your brother was lost and is now found. Ca n't you see what we are looking forward to, he says. Sometimes you get so used to the house. The house becomes your own enemy. The father never left. Why? The father wants you to come back smelling like pigs. He wants to see your love. I, I get really nervous, you know.
